facts.statement: Players were encouraged to challenge friends to see who can bounce the most times between platforms without missing; the last one bouncing wins.
facts.quote: Challenge your friends to see who can bounce the most times between multiple spots without missing!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: SOE's December 2009 'In The Works' post previews a secret feature: a network of bounce platforms placed around the world that catapult the player high into the air. It names Seaside and Snowhill as locations and says the platforms are part of a month that also brings housing, fishing and new pets.
